courses.h2: With us, there's a place for everyone.
courses.lede: We teach English to learners of all ages, from six upwards.

items.title: Primary
items.desc: We guide young learners from the very beginning, introducing reading and writing gradually and helping them to see English as a genuinely useful tool.

items.title: Teenagers
items.desc: Grammar, vocabulary and Use of English, worked on systematically so students progress in all five skills: Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking and Use of English.

items.title: Adults
items.desc: The same structured method, adapted to an adult's pace and needs: solid foundations in grammar and vocabulary, and constant encouragement to overcome any fear of speaking English.

items.title: Cambridge English exams
items.desc:
A Cambridge English Preparation Centre since 2005.

Every student is placed in a group according to their overall level on the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR).

Those who wish to can certify their level of English, with full preparation using authentic exam materials.

We prepare candidates for the Young Learners exams (Pre A1 Starters, A1 Movers and A2 Flyers), A2 Key, B1 Preliminary, B2 First and C1 Advanced.

items.title: Summer courses
items.desc: Intensive preparation courses for official exams. Refresher courses to keep your level up. Conversation classes. Tailor-made private lessons.

items.title: Private lessons
items.desc: During the school year: students aged 16 and over with specific needs (tailored content, flexible timetables...).

exams.lede: Our students don't just study English – most of them go on to certify it. We prepare each level rigorously and enter candidates for the official examinations as a Cambridge English Preparation Centre.

rungs.name: Key (KET)
rungs.desc: The first official certificate, confirming a solid command of everyday written and spoken English.

rungs.name: Preliminary (PET)
rungs.desc: Independent user level. Very useful for intermediate vocational courses, for access to master's degrees and for entry to or promotion in public-sector jobs (armed forces, police, civil service...).

rungs.name: First (FCE)
rungs.desc: The most widely requested certificate in Spain, and a common requirement for university degrees and for many job vacancies.

rungs.name: Advanced (CAE)
rungs.desc: Proficient user level. Opens doors to master's degrees, universities abroad and jobs overseas.

exams.yleNote: The Young Learners series: the first official exams, from the age of seven and without pressure.

method.h2:
A small school
with a long track record.
method.lede:
We opened our doors in September 2005 as the first English school in the town. Since then, our aim has always been the same: to bring English closer to our neighbours and help them learn in a warm, family atmosphere.

We follow a structured progression, with continuous assessment and dedicated, qualified teachers. We have always strived to offer a consistent, high-quality service.

pillars.title: All five skills in every unit
pillars.text: Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking and Use of English. Every skill carries equal weight.

pillars.title: Regular, supervised practice with feedback
pillars.text: Periodic tests and progress reports (primary and secondary). Practice with real Cambridge exam papers.
